affinity.notes: Earthy metal and leather tones read as physical equipment rather than elemental power.

anatomy.notes: Bull head, horns, powerful humanoid frame, and arms are proportionally coherent.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "frontline bruiser" does not semantically communicate Shattered-Arena Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Massive build, horns, and forward-pointing gesture clearly signal charges and heavy melee pressure.

finish.notes: Armor, fur, cloak, and arena detail receive a consistent polished treatment.

framing.notes: The full standing silhouette and broad horn span are clearly contained.

identity.notes: Blind perception "armored minotaur warlord" semantically identifies minotaurs/minotaur-bull-emperor.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
